questions.prompt: Where was Guru Nanak Dev Ji born?

options.label: Rai Bhoi di Talwandi, now Nankana Sahib

questions.explanation: He was born in 1469 in Rai Bhoi di Talwandi, now called Nankana Sahib, in present-day Pakistan.

questions.prompt: What job did he hold in Sultanpur Lodhi?

options.label: Storekeeper for the governor, Daulat Khan Lodi

questions.explanation: He looked after the governor's stores. Village accountant was his father's job in Talwandi.

questions.prompt: In the Sacha Sauda story, what did he do with the money for trading?

options.label: Gave it back to his father
Fed a group of hungry holy men

questions.explanation: He called feeding the hungry the "true bargain", the best trade he could make.

questions.prompt: Which practice means earning an honest living?
questions.explanation: Kirat karni is honest work. Naam japna is remembering the Divine, and vand chhakna is sharing.
